moves.evidence: route name itself states North Basin

evidence: Cilley-Barber is described as the most distinct line in the Chimney Pond Cirque and most of the winter routes (Chauvin-Cole, Cole-Scranton, Waterfall Gully etc.) are climbed from Chimney Pond; Pamola West Ridge and The Chimney have no confirmed place and stay with the majority. https://www.mountainproject.com/route/106061987/cilley-barber

moves.evidence: MP route page: small flow in a cavity between Melinda's Madness and Beginner's Blessing, End Crags

evidence: Beginner's Madness is placed at End Crags (https://www.mountainproject.com/route/109902838/beginners-madness). Icess has no source naming its place (area page only mentions a cave with most ice), so it stays in the leaf and no new name is given; if Beginner's Madness moves, the leaf holds one route and needs a name from the owner.
Leominster Ice Quarry is the real name of a sunny east-facing quarry on Monoosnuc Ridge (https://mountainproject.com/area/118205339/leominster-ice-quarry); the word Ice is part of the place name.
Dry-Tool Cliff is a named cliff in Section 18 near Iron Mountain holding rock top-rope/trad routes plus Ixodes (https://www.mountainproject.com/area/110456482/section-18); stays.
Single route TANG (WI2-3); no source found naming its specific place, so it stays under Blueberry Boulders.

Routes are on Hogback Mountain near Marquette (The Grotto spur at 46.6047,-87.4826 per MP) but no source gave a sub-place name that is not a route name; left unchanged. https://www.mountainproject.com/area/107020309/hogback

moves.evidence: MP: Twin Ponds sits near Enger Tower on Skyline Parkway, Duluth, top-roped from the railing

new.name: Enger Tower
new.evidence: Duluth landmark named in the Twin Ponds route text; no coordinate taken from a source

evidence: The three routes are at different Duluth places; only Twin Ponds is placed by a source (https://www.mountainproject.com/route/106070702/twin-ponds). 8th St. Bridge and Nopoming have no place source and stay.

Center Ice Pillar and Left Icefall are on the private cliff along the St. Croix River reached from the Twin Springs Rd gate (MP old Stillwater Ice, https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105956275/stillwater-ice); no place name from a source, and Fairy Falls is a different spot. contivance is a bouldering row, unplaced.

moves.evidence: Outside Bozeman: Ice Dragons pours off the Giant's Belly, a north-facing wall visible from East Rosebud Lake

evidence: Routes are spread (Hell Roaring Falls near the road, California Ice at the south end of East Rosebud Lake, Ice Dragons on Giant's Belly); no single sourced place name covers the rest, so they stay. https://www.mountainproject.com/area/106213724/east-rosebud-ice-climbing

Blue Gully, Green Gully, Brain Cramp and Pine Creek Falls are all Pine Creek ice (https://summitpost.org/pine-creek-falls/563287); the guide splits Main Fork and South Fork but no source assigns these routes to one, so no new name.
The two rows are links to ice-report photo albums, not climbs at a place; nothing to place. Suggest the owner remove them.

moves.evidence: MP/SummitPost: approached with Thresher and North End Slab past the iron gate to the North End
named North End Slab ice climb at the North End of Cathedral Ledge
Thresher sits between the North End Rock area and the North End Slab ice climbs (MP search snippet)

evidence: All routes are on Cathedral Ledge (https://www.mountainproject.com/area/106099668/cathedral-ledge-ice-climbs); only the three North End routes are placed by a source. No source names a sub-place for Remission, Repentance, Submission, Goofers, Unicorn, Schnoz, Housewarming, 30 Years, so they stay and the leaf is not renamed.
